newsitem.title: CHINA: New Shanghai museum opens to huge crowds.
newsitem.headline: New Shanghai museum opens to huge crowds.

text.p: The new Shanghai Museum, a $68 million structure that experts have called the most impressive museum building in the Chinese world, opened on Saturday with massive crowds of visitors filling its 13 galleries.

The museum, on the edge of People's Square in the centre of the city, has more than 4,000 works of art and antiquity on display in galleries that are designed and lit in the manner of top international museums.
Three special exhibitions are being held to coincide with the formal opening, including a show of 64 Western masterpieces owned by Carmen Thyssen-Bornemisza of Spain.
